tools.name: find_deploying_seed_funds
tools.description: Find seed and pre-seed VC funds that are actively deploying capital right now, filtered by sector and optionally city. Use when a founder asks which VCs/investors are investing in a sector now, or for a seed investor list. Returns fund name, HQ, check size, why we believe it is deploying, and a DryP

tools.name: recent_vc_form_d_filings
tools.description: List venture funds that recently filed SEC Form D (a sign they just raised a new fund and will be writing checks). Use for 'which VC funds just raised' or 'new VC funds this month'.
